reserves.name: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills and USD
reserves.issuerOrObligor: United States Treasury and regulated USD custodians

reserveReview.rationale: OpenEden documents one-to-one backing by short-dated U.S. Treasury bills and a small USD component, with BNY managing and custodying the Treasury portfolio and daily/monthly NAV reporting. None of the reviewed current pages provides a dated percentage allocation, so the prior 95/5 split is replaced by one unresolved two-constituent basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: OpenEden TBILL fund, FAQ, and trust-and-transparency disclosures without current category weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The Treasury and USD constituents are identified, but their current weights and the USD provider allocation are not published in a pinned report.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills and USD
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: OpenEden identifies both reserve constituents but does not publish a current dated Treasury-versus-USD allocation.

providers.name: Regulated TBILL Fund cash custodians and service providers

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden documents BNY for the Treasury portfolio and segregated Treasury custody, but the reviewed sources do not identify the cash custodian, provider shares, or complete rehypothecation terms.
